PINE HOLLOW COUNTY SCHOOLS
INDIVIDUALIZED EDUCATION PROGRAM
Student information
Student: Okafor, Maya Date of Birth: 04/19/2013 Grade: 7 Student ID: PH-208114
Address: 72 Laurel Court, Pine Hollow, NC 27999
Parent: Grace Okafor Phone: (555) 010-2088 Email: grace.okafor@example.com
School: Cedar Ridge Middle School LEA: Pine Hollow County Schools
Eligibility Category: Speech or Language Impairment Initial Eligibility Date: 02/14/2020
IEP Meeting Date: 08/21/2025 Meeting Purpose: Annual Review Duration of IEP: 08/21/2025 to
08/20/2026
Present level of academic and functional performance
Speech-Language: On the CELF-5 administered 05/06/2025, Maya obtained a Core Language Score of
71 (2nd percentile). Expressive Language Index 68; Receptive Language Index 79. In class, Maya
produces sentences of four to six words, omits verb tense markers, and does not retell a paragraph-length
passage in sequence. Teacher report: Maya does not raise her hand and gives one-word answers when
called on.
Parent input: The parent reports that Maya has become reluctant to speak in class and at home about
school. The parent asks that speech-language therapy remain at the current level and that the district
assess written expression, which was not assessed in May 2025.
Annual goals
Goal 1 - Expressive Language. By 08/20/2026, given a picture sequence, Maya will retell a four-event
narrative using complete sentences with correct past-tense verb forms in 4 of 5 trials, as measured by SLP
data collection. Baseline (05/2025): 1 of 5 trials.
Goal 2 - Classroom Participation. By 08/20/2026, Maya will respond to a teacher question with a
complete sentence of five or more words in 8 of 10 opportunities across two class periods, as measured by
teacher tally. Baseline: 2 of 10.
Special education and related services
Speech-Language Therapy: 60 minutes per week, individual, provided by a licensed speech-language
pathologist in the speech room, 08/21/2025 to 08/20/2026.
Specially Designed Instruction - Written Expression: 45 minutes per week, small group, provided by an
EC teacher in the resource room, 08/21/2025 to 08/20/2026.
Least restrictive environment
Maya will be in the regular education setting for 92% of the school day. Removal is limited to
speech-language therapy and resource instruction.

IEP team
Grace Okafor (Parent); Daniel Whitfield (LEA Representative, Assistant Principal); Ana Lucero, M.S.,
CCC-SLP (Speech-Language Pathologist); Robert Chen (EC Teacher); Kim Aldana (Regular Education
Teacher, English Language Arts).
Prior written notice of the IEP team decisions
The IEP team proposes to continue speech-language therapy at 60 minutes per week and to add 45
minutes per week of specially designed instruction in written expression. The team declined the parent's
request to reevaluate written expression, on the basis that the 05/06/2025 evaluation is current and the
added instruction addresses the concern. The parent may request an independent educational evaluation if
the parent disagrees with the district's evaluation.
The parent signed the IEP on 08/21/2025 and wrote: "I agree with the services. I still want written
expression tested."
